Track-length velocity of each initiation zone

Source: R/izones.R
fit_all_izone_velocities.Rd

For each IZ, fit a GAM log1p(mid_track_len) ~ s(rep_percent) (mgcv::gam, GCV, k = max(4, min(gam_basis_k, n_unique - 1, n - 2))) to its tracks (finite values, rep_percent in [0, 1], positive length) and compare it with an intercept-only model. The fitted length curve on n_curve_points grid points gives the velocity (bp per percent, central finite differences). IZs with fewer than min_points_per_izone tracks or fewer than 5 distinct rep_percent values are not fitted. GAM p-values are BH-adjusted (non-finite p-values count as 1); a velocity model passes if the fit is ok, fdr < fdr_threshold and the GAM has the lower AIC.

Usage

fit_all_izone_velocities(
  df,
  izone_ids,
  min_points_per_izone,
  gam_basis_k = 10L,
  n_curve_points = 101L,
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

df

A data.frame with columns iz_id, rep_percent (fraction) and mid_track_len (bp), one row per track.

izone_ids

IZ ids to fit (also those without rows).

min_points_per_izone

Minimum number of tracks per IZ.

gam_basis_k

Maximum basis dimension (e.g. 10).

n_curve_points

Number of curve points, at least 3 (e.g. 101).

fdr_threshold

FDR threshold (e.g. 0.05).

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over IZs.

Value

A list with summary (one row per IZ: fit statistics, fdr, delta_aic_null_minus_gam, aic_pass, velocity_model_pass, velocity_direction, fit_status), curves (fitted length and velocity per grid point) and config (the parameters used).
